title: Locked Statement-of-Work Rate Discounts and TimeBank Project Draws
content:
**Project discount schedule.** On TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours, the block hours of a group on a Professional Services Projects statement of work with a locked rate discount of at least 10 percent are multiplied by 0.9; those of a group on one with a locked discount above zero and below 10 percent, by 0.95; those of a group on one with no locked discount, by 1. The locked rate discount is the labor rate discount locked at signature on the statement of work the group is logged under.

| Locked rate discount on the statement of work | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 10 percent or more | 0.9 |
| above 0 and below 10 percent | 0.95 |
| none (0) | 1 |

Hypothetical boundary cases: a discount of 9.5 percent gives 0.95 and one of 10.0 percent gives 0.9; a group converting to 4.00 hours before this multiplier draws 3.60 or 3.80 hours respectively.
